file_info.description: VFX & Special Features - Optional module for supernatural elements and specific color palettes

prompts.Crucial Constraints - Animal Features: - If present in [REFERENCE_IMG], recreate animal ears and tails with highly realistic fur textures that seamlessly blend with the character's hair. They should look like natural biological features, not cheap props.
prompts.Crucial Constraints - Halo VFX: - If present in [REFERENCE_IMG], render the Halo as a luminous, high-quality CG energy ring. It should have a subtle ethereal glow (bloom effect) and cast realistic ambient light onto the subject's hair and shoulders.
prompts.Crucial Constraints - Styling: - Vividly render [HAIR_COLOR] hair and clear, transparent [EYE_COLOR] pupils as seen in the [REFERENCE_IMG].
